title: Introduce a deterministic Python Agent Runtime planning core
goal: Create a dependency-free Python planning layer that classifies requests and emits typed proposals without executing tools or granting capabilities.
context: Swift remains responsible for iOS UI, permission decisions, policy enforcement, and tool execution. Python is intended to become the Agent reasoning/orchestration layer; this task adds a deterministic planner contract as the first incremental step.
forbidden_changes: Do not execute tools, access the filesystem, or invoke shell commands from the Python planner.
Do not let Python grant permissions, bypass Swift policy, or claim an action succeeded.
Do not add third-party runtime dependencies.
Do not change existing Swift runtime behavior or the Xcode project in this task.
acceptance_criteria: The Python package exposes typed request, intent, plan, and proposal contracts.
A deterministic planner recognizes generic chat and incomplete or complete create-file requests in Vietnamese and English.
Incomplete create-file requests return missing fields and never propose an action.
A complete create-file request produces only a proposal when the capability is explicitly in the allowed skill set.
Missing capability fails closed with a non-executable plan.
Standard-library unit tests cover the main classification and fail-closed cases.
A dedicated GitHub Actions workflow runs the Python tests and validates the task contract.
verification: Review that planner code has no filesystem, subprocess, network, or tool-execution imports.
recovery: Keep the planner pure and deterministic. If natural-language parsing becomes ambiguous, return a clarification plan instead of guessing a path or content.
